claim.statement: impl_b under-samples the first k items.

explanations.statement: The bias is about 1/k: the first-k ratio is near (k-1)/k, so larger reservoirs hide it.
The bias depends on stream length, not on k.

plan.implementation_note: Only impl_b, n=100, 2,000 trials per seed.

metrics.description: Inclusion frequency of the first k items divided by k/n.
metrics.label: First-k inclusion ratio

plan.question: Does the under-sampling of the first k items shrink as k grows?
plan.title: Does group B's bias depend on the reservoir size?
